import pytest
from impl import run

R = [
    {'id': 1, 'date': '2026-07-01', 'customer': 'A', 'text': 'x'},
    {'id': 2, 'date': '2026-07-02', 'customer': 'B', 'text': 'y'},
    {'id': 3, 'date': '2026-07-03', 'customer': 'A', 'text': 'z'},
    {'id': 4, 'date': '2026-07-04', 'customer': 'C', 'text': 'w'},
]
L = [
    {'id': 1, 'theme': 'toner', 'sentiment': 'complaint'},
    {'id': 2, 'theme': 'toner', 'sentiment': 'complaint'},
    {'id': 3, 'theme': 'price', 'sentiment': 'praise'},
    {'id': 4, 'theme': 'delay', 'sentiment': 'complaint'},
]


def test_basic():
    o = run({'records': R, 'labels': L})
    assert o['total_complaints'] == 3
    assert o['ranking'][0]['theme'] == 'toner'
    assert o['ranking'][0]['count'] == 2
    assert o['ranking'][0]['record_ids'] == [1, 2]
    assert o['ranking'][0]['customers'] == ['A', 'B']


def test_top_n():
    o = run({'records': R, 'labels': L, 'top_n': 1})
    assert len(o['ranking']) == 1


def test_unlabelled():
    o = run({'records': R + [{'id': 9}], 'labels': L})
    assert o['unlabelled_record_ids'] == [9]


def test_bad():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': 'x', 'labels': []})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': [], 'labels': [], 'top_n': 0})

import pytest
from impl import run


def _data():
    recs = [
        {'id': 1, 'date': '2026-07-01', 'customer': 'A', 'text': 'Toner leaked'},
        {'id': 2, 'date': '2026-07-02', 'customer': 'B', 'text': 'Late'},
        {'id': 3, 'date': '2026-07-03', 'customer': 'C', 'text': 'Great'},
        {'id': 4, 'date': '2026-07-04', 'customer': 'A', 'text': 'Toner leaked'},
    ]
    labs = [
        {'id': 1, 'theme': 'toner', 'sentiment': 'complaint'},
        {'id': 2, 'theme': 'delay', 'sentiment': 'complaint'},
        {'id': 3, 'theme': 'pricing', 'sentiment': 'praise'},
        {'id': 4, 'theme': 'toner', 'sentiment': 'complaint'},
    ]
    return recs, labs


def test_basic():
    r, l = _data()
    out = run({'records': r, 'labels': l, 'top_n': 5})
    assert out['total_complaints'] == 3
    top = out['ranking'][0]
    assert top['theme'] == 'toner'
    assert top['count'] == 2
    assert top['record_ids'] == [1, 4]
    assert top['customers'] == ['A']
    assert top['example_texts'] == ['Toner leaked']
    assert len(out['ranking']) == 2


def test_top_n():
    r, l = _data()
    out = run({'records': r, 'labels': l, 'top_n': 1})
    assert len(out['ranking']) == 1


def test_unmatched_label():
    r, l = _data()
    l.append({'id': 99, 'theme': 'x', 'sentiment': 'complaint'})
    out = run({'records': r, 'labels': l})
    assert out['unmatched_labels'] == 1
    assert out['total_complaints'] == 3


def test_bad_input():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': 'x', 'labels': []})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': [], 'labels': [], 'top_n': 0})
